There are incredible anime out there right now that you have completely overlooked. Not because they are bad or hard to find, but because of how they were sold, when they were released, or what they look like.

In this video, we explore the four main reasons amazing shows get buried. From Odd Taxi hiding a gripping crime thriller behind cozy animal designs, to Akiba Maid War disguising a violent Yakuza story as a slice-of-life comedy, and the catastrophic double-paywall release of Land of the Lustrous. Plus, we dive into a few impossible-to-market masterpieces like Showa Genroku Rakugo Shinju, Aria the Animation, and more.
